ATSAVI.formula: sla * (N - sla * R - slb) / (sla * N + R - sla * slb + 0.08 * (1 + sla ** 2.0))
ATSAVI.name: Adjusted Transformed Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index

AWEIsh.name: Automated Water Extraction Index with Shadows Elimination

BAIM.name: Burned Area Index adapted to MODIS

BWDRVI.name: Blue Wide Dynamic Range Vegetation Index

CI1woSWIR.name: Cloud Index Form 1 without SWIR bands

CI2SWIR.name: Cloud Index Form 2 with SWIR bands

CI2woSWIR.name: Cloud Index Form 2 without SWIR bands

CSIwoSWIR.name: Cloud Shadow Index without SWIR bands

DVIplus.formula: ((lambdaN - lambdaR)/(lambdaN - lambdaG)) * G + (1.0 - ((lambdaN - lambdaR)/(lambdaN - lambdaG))) * N - R
DVIplus.name: Difference Vegetation Index Plus

GOSAVI.name: Green Optimized Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index

GRARI.formula: (N - (eta * G + (1.0 - eta) * R - lmb * (B - R)))/(N + (eta * G + (1.0 - eta) * R - lmb * (B - R)))
GRARI.name: Atmospheric Resistant Green-Red Index

MCARI.name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index

MCARI1.name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 1

MCARI2.name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 2

MCARI705.name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index (705 and 750 nm)

MLSWI26.name: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 6)

MLSWI27.name: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 7)

NBLIOLI.name: Normalized Difference Bare Land Index for Landsat-OLI

NBSIMS.name: Non-Binary Snow Index for Multi-Component Surfaces

NDGI.formula: (((lambdaN - lambdaR)/(lambdaN - lambdaG)) * G + (1.0 - ((lambdaN - lambdaR)/(lambdaN - lambdaG))) * N - R)/(((lambdaN - lambdaR)/(lambdaN - lambdaG)) * G + (1.0 - ((lambdaN - lambdaR)/(lambdaN - lambdaG))) * N + R)
NDGI.name: Normalized Difference Greenness Index

NDISIb.name: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Blue

NDISIg.name: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Green

NDISImndwi.name: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index with MNDWI

NDISIndwi.name: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index with NDWI

NDISIr.name: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Red

NDPI.formula: (N - (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S1))/(N + (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S1))
NDPI.name: Normalized Difference Phenology Index

NDSIITM.name: Normalized Difference Snow/Ice Index for Landsat TM

NDSInw.name: Normalized Difference Snow Index with no Water

NDSaII.name: Normalized Difference Snow and Ice Index

NDTI4RE.formula: gamma * (S1 - S2)/(S1 + S2) + (1 - gamma) * (N - RE3)/(N + RE3)
NDTI4RE.name: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Tillage Index

NDVI4RE.formula: ((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) - (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1))/((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) + (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1))
NDVI4RE.name: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index

NDVI705.name: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (705 and 750 nm)

NDWIns.name: Normalized Difference Water Index with no Snow Cover and Glaciers

NIRvP.name: Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation and Incoming PAR

NSDSI1.name: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 1

NSDSI2.name: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 2

NSDSI3.name: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 3

RENDVI.name: Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index

RVI4RE.formula: (alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2)/(beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1)
RVI4RE.name: 4-band Red Edge Ratio Vegetation Index

SARVI.name: Soil Adjusted and Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index

SAVI4RE.formula: 2.0 * ((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) - (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1))/((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) + (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1 + 1))
SAVI4RE.name: 4-band Red Edge Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index

SNDTI4RE.name: 4-band Red Edge Soil-Adjusted Normalized Difference Tillage Index

TCARI.name: Transformed Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index

TSAVI.formula: sla * (N - sla * R - slb) / (sla * N + R - sla * slb)
TSAVI.name: Transformed Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index

WCI1.formula: -1.0 * ((B - R + RE1)/(B + R + RE1 + epsilon)) * ((G + R)/(B + N + epsilon))
WCI1.name: Wheat Canopy Index (Growth Stage 1)

WCI2.formula: -1.0 * ((B + G + RE1)/(R + epsilon)) * ((B + R + RE1)/(N + epsilon))
WCI2.name: Wheat Canopy Index (Growth Stage 2)

kEVI.formula: g * (kNN - kNR) / (kNN + C1 * kNR - C2 * kNB + kNL)
kEVI.name: Kernel Enhanced Vegetation Index

sNIRvLSWI.name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for LSWI

sNIRvNDPI.formula: (N - (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S2))/(N + (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S2)) * N
sNIRvNDPI.name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for NDPI

sNIRvNDVILSWIP.name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Product

sNIRvNDVILSWIS.name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Sum
